description: Surface every repo component as user-selectable in the install dialogs via CHECKBOXES (a multi-select --checklist step) AND equivalent COMMAND-LINE / env-var entry, then wire the selections all the way through to actual installation. This is the UX core of the request ('We'd like check boxes and perhaps command lines for entry' + 'make sure all we've worked on is available for the install dialogs'). Depends on FEAT-002 (install-os-security.sh) and FEAT-003 (install-git-improved.sh) so those scripts exist to be invoked. Edits scripts/galactic-cherry-installer (the whiptail/dialog/text TUI) and keeps scripts/install-ubuntu-installer.sh advertising consistent.
steps: In scripts/galactic-cherry-installer, add a new state variable INSTALL_COMPONENTS (space- or comma-separated list) and a new wizard step step_components() placed AFTER step_desktop and BEFORE step_disk. Register it in the main() call sequence (currently step_welcome -> step_desktop -> step_disk -> step_user -> step_confirm -> step_install -> step_done).

Implement step_components with a `--checklist` for the whiptail/dialog frontends, exposing every component built in this repo as a toggleable item with sensible default ON/OFF states: ubuntu-white (Ubuntu White theme/icons overlay, default ON), security (OS security suite incl. ClamAV/UFW/AppArmor/fail2ban/unattended-upgrades, default ON), git-improved (improved Git + git-lfs, default ON), jwstf (JWSTF / NitroWebExpress Java web server, default OFF), plus any other first-class components already present (e.g. MATE is handled by step_desktop, so it need not be duplicated here). Use the existing $DIALOG/$ROWS/$COLS/$LIST_ROWS variables and the 3>&1 1>&2 2>&3 redirection pattern already used by step_desktop's radiolist.

Provide a numbered text-mode fallback for step_components consistent with the existing text fallback in step_desktop: present each component with a [x]/[ ] default and let the user toggle by entering numbers, or accept a comma list. Ensure INSTALL_COMPONENTS ends up populated identically regardless of frontend.

Add CLI-flag / env entry so the same selections can be driven headlessly (matching the existing INSTALL_DESKTOP/GNOME_THEME/DESKTOP env-var convention). Parse argv at the top of main(): support `--desktop <mate|gnome|vanilla>`, `--enable <comma,list>`, `--disable <comma,list>`, `--non-interactive` (skip TUI, use provided/default selections), and `--help` (print usage listing every component and flag). Also honor env vars INSTALL_DESKTOP and INSTALL_COMPONENTS (or GC_COMPONENTS) so `INSTALL_COMPONENTS='ubuntu-white,security,git-improved' ...` works. When --non-interactive or a full env selection is supplied, skip the corresponding interactive steps.

Wire selections through to step_install: after the existing desktop-install case and BEFORE/around the current JWSTF block, add guarded installation calls that run each selected component inside the chroot target the same way the existing MATE/JWSTF blocks do (copy the script into $target/tmp when not already present at a well-known path, then `chroot $target bash /tmp/<script>` with `>> $LOG 2>&1` and a non-fatal warning on error). Map: security -> scripts/install-os-security.sh; git-improved -> scripts/install-git-improved.sh; ubuntu-white -> ensure GNOME_THEME/UBUNTU_WHITE_ICONS env are exported into the gnome desktop install (it already applies the overlay for gnome); jwstf -> gate the EXISTING JWSTF block on whether 'jwstf' is in INSTALL_COMPONENTS instead of always attempting it. Update progress() percentages/labels so the gauge reflects the new steps.

Update step_confirm to list the selected optional components in the summary, and step_welcome text so the advertised 'Security tools (chkrootkit, rkhunter, ClamAV)' now matches what is actually installable/selected. Keep scripts/install-ubuntu-installer.sh's security slide (lines ~182-188) consistent with the actual component names.

Ensure backward compatibility: if step_components is skipped or INSTALL_COMPONENTS is empty, fall back to the prior behavior defaults (theme applied for gnome as today; JWSTF must NOT run unless explicitly selected, since it was previously attempted unconditionally -- document this behavior change in the change summary).
acceptance_criteria: scripts/galactic-cherry-installer passes `bash -n` with exit 0 after all edits.
A step_components function exists, uses `--checklist` for whiptail/dialog and a numbered text fallback, and is invoked from main() between step_desktop and step_disk.

The installer accepts CLI flags --desktop, --enable, --disable, --non-interactive, --help and honors INSTALL_COMPONENTS/INSTALL_DESKTOP env vars (grep-confirmable), so selections can be made without interaction.

step_install contains guarded chroot invocations of scripts/install-os-security.sh and scripts/install-git-improved.sh conditioned on INSTALL_COMPONENTS, and the JWSTF block is now conditioned on the 'jwstf' selection rather than running unconditionally.
step_confirm summary and step_welcome text reflect the selectable components; install-ubuntu-installer.sh security slide remains consistent.
`--help` output lists every selectable component (ubuntu-white, security, git-improved, jwstf) and every flag.
verification: Run `bash -n scripts/galactic-cherry-installer` and `bash -n scripts/install-ubuntu-installer.sh` and confirm exit 0 for both.
Run `grep -nE 'step_components|--checklist|INSTALL_COMPONENTS|--enable|--non-interactive|--help' scripts/galactic-cherry-installer` and confirm the checklist step and CLI entry are present.
Run `grep -nE 'install-os-security.sh|install-git-improved.sh' scripts/galactic-cherry-installer` and confirm both security and git-improved are wired into step_install.

Run `grep -n 'jwstf' scripts/galactic-cherry-installer` and confirm the JWSTF install block is now gated on component selection (a conditional referencing INSTALL_COMPONENTS/jwstf appears around the JWSTF block).
findings: Implemented in scripts/galactic-cherry-installer: new state var INSTALL_COMPONENTS (honors INSTALL_COMPONENTS/GC_COMPONENTS env, normalizes comma->space), parallel COMPONENT_IDS/COMPONENT_DESCS/COMPONENT_DEFAULTS arrays, and helpers component_selected/components_enable/components_disable/usage. Added step_components() between step_desktop and step_disk using --checklist (whiptail/dialog) with the 3>&1 1>&2 2>&3 pattern plus a numbered text-mode toggle fallback; both frontends populate INSTALL_COMPONENTS identically. argv parsing added at top of main(): --desktop, --enable, --disable, --non-interactive, --help/-h; unknown flags error out. --non-interactive / preset selections skip step_desktop and step_components (defaults: desktop=mate, components='ubuntu-white security git-improved'). step_install now has guarded chroot invocations for security -> install-os-security.sh and git-improved -> install-git-improved.sh (copy-to-/tmp + chroot bash + non-fatal WARNING, matching the MATE/JWSTF pattern); ubuntu-white exports GNOME_THEME=ubuntu-white/UBUNTU_WHITE_ICONS=1 into a gnome-path install-gnome-desktop.sh invocation. Progress gauge percentages relabeled (68 security, 72 git, 76 jwstf). step_confirm now lists selected Components; step_welcome text updated to advertise the four selectable optional components. install-ubuntu-installer.sh security slide extended with UFW+AppArmor and fail2ban+unattended-upgrades for consistency. BEHAVIOR CHANGE: the JWSTF/NitroWebExpress block previously ran unconditionally in step_install; it is now gated on 'jwstf' being present in INSTALL_COMPONENTS (default OFF), so JWSTF only installs when explicitly selected. VERIFICATION: bash -n passes (exit 0) for both galactic-cherry-installer and install-ubuntu-installer.sh; all FEAT-004 grep checks confirm step_components/--checklist/INSTALL_COMPONENTS/CLI flags, both security+git scripts wired into step_install, and JWSTF gated on component_selected jwstf. Helper enable/disable/dedup/membership logic exercised in an isolated bash harness and behaves correctly. Could not exercise the TUI interactively (no whiptail/dialog/shellcheck on host, restricted network) per environment constraints; static validation only, as documented in context.json. REVIEW v1 (2026-08-31) follow-up: (1) ubuntu-white overlay was applied only inside the gnome case of step_install, so selecting it with mate/vanilla silently no-op'd; added an auditable NOTE ('ubuntu-white theme requires the gnome desktop — skipping overlay for <desktop>') after the desktop case, matching the NOTE pattern used by the other components. (2) Added `[ -n "${2:-}" ]` operand guards with clear ERROR messages before `shift 2` for --desktop/--enable/--disable so a value-less trailing flag exits 1 cleanly instead of misbehaving under set -e. (3) JWSTF default-OFF confirmed intentional and left as-is: documented in the DEFAULT_COMPONENTS comment, COMPONENT_DEFAULTS array, and printed as '(default OFF)' in --help output. (4) step_disk's `eval $DIALOG` idiom left unchanged: pre-existing, out of core scope, and not safely testable without a dialog frontend on host. bash -n still exit 0 after fixes.
